title: The category of abelian sheaves on a site is abelian, with kernel and cokernel described by presheaf operations and sheafification

standard_prerequisites.name: Adjoint functors yielding an abelian structure on the target category
standard_prerequisites.use: The general criterion applied to the inclusion and sheafification pair, from which abelianness and the kernel/cokernel descriptions follow.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sheafification of abelian presheaves: adjointness and left exactness
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the properties of sheafification that the criterion's hypotheses require.

core_obligations: Check the three hypotheses of the adjunction criterion for abelian categories applied to the inclusion a of abelian sheaves into abelian presheaves and the sheafification b: additivity and adjointness, abelianness of the presheaf category together with left exactness of sheafification, and ba isomorphic to the identity (proof lines 374-388).
Conclude from the criterion that the category of abelian sheaves is abelian (proof lines 388-390).

Use the proof of the criterion to obtain that kernels and cokernels are the sheafifications of the presheaf kernel and cokernel, giving (4); since the kernel is a finite limit and sheafification commutes with finite limits, deduce (2) (proof lines 391-397).

Derive the remaining statements: (2) implies (3); (4) implies (5) via the description of sheafification; and (6) from (2) and (5) together with the identification of exactness as the equality of image and kernel (proof lines 398-404).
proof_roadmap: Verify the hypotheses of the general adjoint-functor criterion.
Transfer the descriptions of kernel and cokernel, then deduce the remaining parts.
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six facts about abelian sheaves on a site: that the category is abelian, that kernels agree with presheaf kernels, characterizations of injectivity, that cokernels are the sheafification of presheaf cokernels, characterizations of surjectivity, and the covering-wise criterion for exactness. The proof verifies the three hypotheses of the general adjunction criterion for the inclusion of abelian sheaves into abelian presheaves together with sheafification - additivity and adjointness, abelianness of the presheaf category with left exact sheafification, and the counit being an isomorphism - then reads off abelianness from that criterion (proof lines 373-408). The descriptions of kernel and cokernel follow from the proof of the cited criterion, and the remaining statements are then deduced from them (2) implies (3), (4) implies (5) by the description of sheafification, and (6) from (2) and (5)). H2: the verification of the criterion's hypotheses and the systematic deductions are the substance.
